claim:recover-mass-action.hypothesis:
Mass-action is the floor: linear/bilinear rate laws and a handful of reactions.
The cycle should recover both the trajectory (to tight tolerance) and the exact
reaction set + rate constants with no spurious reactions, calibrating the
trajectory and structural scoring for the whole ladder.

claim:recover-enzyme-kinetics.hypothesis:
Both the elementary mechanism and the reduced saturating law fit the observed
product/substrate trajectories. The cycle recovers the trajectory out of the box,
but choosing the right structural form requires a rate-law-fitter and a parsimony
evaluator: with only substrate/product observed, the reduced MM law is the
parsimonious recovery; the elementary steps are only warranted if ES is observed.

claim:recover-gene-switch.hypothesis:
Genuine nonlinearity and bistability mean a one-shot fit is insufficient: the
cycle's frontier (what the current candidate fails to explain — e.g. the second
stable branch or the switch sharpness) must drive the search. The loop recovers
the Hill term (coefficient and threshold) and reproduces bistability only once
reaction-proposal + rate-law-fitting capabilities handle the nonlinear regulation.

claim:recover-oscillator.hypothesis:
Dynamic structure is the hardest recovery: a model can track one trajectory
window yet fail to sustain the limit cycle. The cycle recovers the oscillation
only when it recovers the feedback topology (the repression/autocatalytic loop),
which demands frontier-driven proposal of the right reactions plus parameter
fitting that preserves the Hopf regime — the rung most likely to expose capability
gaps and, if unrecoverable as flat SBML, to trigger the non-recoverability check.

claim:recover-stochastic-abm.proposition: Reject a stochastic system (no flat-SBML form)
claim:recover-stochastic-abm.hypothesis:
A single Gillespie trajectory at low copy numbers has noisy derivatives that no
smooth polynomial (mass-action) RHS can fit, so the non-recoverability detector
flags it (worst-species R^2 well below threshold). The underlying network IS flat
SBML only in the large-population mean-field limit; from this data it is not
recoverable. The adversarial passes by correctly REJECTING the system — the honest
failure that keeps the loop from overfitting noise.

narrative.question:
Run as a closed build -> simulate -> compare -> refine loop, can the
discovery-engine cycle recover faithful FLAT SBML models from synthetic
time-series targets across a ladder of biological scenarios (mass-action ->
enzyme kinetics -> gene switch -> oscillator), and what modular, vivarium-style
capabilities must be built to close the gaps where it can't?

units.proposition: Reject a stochastic system (no flat-SBML form)
